INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

2. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

3. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

4. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

5. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.

6. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

8. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.

9. When practising Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.

10. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.

11. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Self – expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Expressing Self Creatively and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
